observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black console with a white label and a black controller in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same console with the 'XBOX' logo visible on the left side.
The console has visible scratches and scuffs on the surface.
The controller is black with standard Xbox buttons (A, B, X, Y) and the Xbox logo.
The console appears to be a standard Xbox One model, not the newer Xbox Series X or S.
The label on the back in photo 0 is partially legible but not fully readable.
The seller claims it includes one pad and power adaptor, but no such accessories are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox one console with one pad and power adaptor
claims.evidence: The console is identifiable as an Xbox One, but the controller and power adaptor are not visible in the photos. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, displaying the home screen, and responding to controller input.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or missing buttons/ports
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the controller's buttons, joysticks, and ports, showing no damage or missing parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing or non-functional controller

risks.risk: Power adaptor may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: A photo or video of the power adaptor, showing it is present and functional when plugged into the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the front label showing the model number.
Video of the console powering on and showing the home screen.
Close-up photo or video of the controller's buttons and ports.
Photo or video of the power adaptor plugged in and working.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
